         9                  THE PRESIDENT:    Our prayer today

        10       will be offered, as it has been so many times,

        11       by the very wonderful and renowned Reverend

        12       Peter G. Young, now with Mother Theresa

        13       Community right here on 2nd Avenue in Albany.

        14                  REVEREND YOUNG:    Forty-eight

        15       years of doing the same thing.

        16                  Dear God, as we begin the 230th

        17       session, we all have a variety of resolutions

        18       that are environment, energy, disaster

        19       preparedness, economic development, urban

        20       planning, schools, DSS, taxes, community,

        21       healthcare, crime, tech and government

        22       spending.  And without dedication to your

        23       guidelines, O God, these 2007 resolutions will

        24       be words without results.

        25                  We turn to You, O God, for these
